sprint_note: Sprint02 adds the shopping_tasks table, restock_quantity field on items, shopping task CRUD endpoints, auto-task creation on low_stock/out_of_stock transition, item state reset on task completion, and a Shopping List UI view.
summary: Household item tracking application. Users create and maintain items categorised as consumable, object, or pending_action. Items have a lifecycle state and optional quantity tracking. Shopping tasks are derived from item state (low_stock/out_of_stock) and close the action loop back to the item on completion.

classification.why_application: Owns the storagetracker schema in Postgres (items + item_history + shopping_tasks tables), enforces item-domain business rules (state auto-transition, history recording, quantity constraints, shopping task auto-creation), and exposes domain-specific read views. Contains no reusable infrastructure.
classification.not_platform: Item domain rules, the storagetracker schema, quantity-driven state transitions, history recording, and shopping task lifecycle are StorageTracker-specific application behavior, not reusable platform infrastructure.

consumes: Shared Atlas Postgres instance (02_Platform/Postgres) — connection via DATABASE_URL or ATLAS_PG_* environment variables
platform_errorhandling — api_error helper, exception handlers, request timing, structured logging
provides: GET /api/items — list all items; params: state (stored|low_stock|out_of_stock|marked_for_recycling|missing|lent_out), item_type (consumable|object|pending_action), location (exact match string), source_tag (string — matches any element of source_tags array); default ordering: created_at DESC; returns Dataset

POST /api/items — create item; body: {name, item_type, location?, notes?, source_tags?: list[str], quantity?: int, min_quantity?: int, restock_quantity?: int, state? (default stored)}; auto-transitions state to low_stock if quantity and min_quantity are both set and quantity <= min_quantity; records history entry with change_type=created; returns Dataset (single row)
GET /api/items/{id} — get single item with last 20 history entries; returns Dataset (single row with embedded history)

[CHANGED] PATCH /api/items/{id} — partial update; body: any subset of {name, state, location, quantity, min_quantity, restock_quantity, notes, source_tags}; field omission means no change; explicit null clears nullable fields; after any quantity or min_quantity change, auto-recomputes state; if state becomes low_stock or out_of_stock, auto-creates open shopping task if none exists; returns Dataset (single row)
DELETE /api/items/{id} — delete item, its history, and its shopping tasks; returns empty Dataset on success, 404 ApiError if not found
GET /api/items/{id}/history — full history for item ordered by timestamp DESC; returns Dataset
GET /api/items/views/low_stock — items where state is low_stock or out_of_stock; ordered by name ASC; returns Dataset
GET /api/items/views/recycling — items where state is marked_for_recycling; ordered by name ASC; returns Dataset
GET /api/items/views/important — items where item_type is object; ordered by name ASC; returns Dataset
GET /api/items/views/search?q=<text> — case-insensitive substring search across name, location, notes; returns Dataset ordered by name ASC; empty q returns empty Dataset
[NEW] GET /api/shopping-tasks — list tasks; params: status (default: open), source_tag (exact match of any element in task.source_tags); ordered by created_at ASC; returns Dataset

[NEW] POST /api/shopping-tasks — manually create a task; body: {item_id, notes?: str}; item must exist; creates with status=open; copies source_tags from item at creation time; fails 409 if an open task already exists for this item; returns Dataset (single row)

[NEW] PATCH /api/shopping-tasks/{id} — update task; body: {status: done|dismissed, notes?: str}; on status=done, resets item state (see invariants); on status=dismissed, no item change; returns Dataset (single row)
[NEW] DELETE /api/shopping-tasks/{id} — delete task; returns empty Dataset on success, 404 ApiError if not found

[NEW] GET /api/shopping-tasks/views/by_source — open tasks expanded by source_tag; one flat row per (task, source_tag); tasks with no source tags produce one row with source_tag='Other'; tasks with multiple source tags appear in each group; rows are ShoppingTaskRow columns plus source_tag; returns Dataset
invariants: All read endpoints (GET) return Dataset per R-CON-BP-04
item.id is a UUID generated at insert time; never caller-supplied
item.name must not be empty or blank (enforced at API level)
item.item_type must be one of: consumable, object, pending_action (enforced at API and DB constraint level)
item.state must be one of: stored, low_stock, out_of_stock, marked_for_recycling, missing, lent_out (enforced at API and DB constraint level)
item.quantity must be null or a non-negative integer; enforced at API level
item.min_quantity must be null or a non-negative integer; enforced at API level
[NEW] item.restock_quantity must be null or a non-negative integer; enforced at API level
item.source_tags is a JSON array of strings stored as jsonb; default empty array []

Auto-transition rule: after any write that sets quantity or min_quantity, if both quantity and min_quantity are non-null and quantity <= min_quantity, state is set to low_stock — UNLESS the caller explicitly provided state in the same request body (caller-supplied state wins)

[NEW] Auto-task creation rule: after any PATCH or POST to items that results in state becoming low_stock or out_of_stock (whether by auto-transition or explicit caller state), check if an open shopping task exists for this item; if not, create one synchronously with source_tags copied from item at that moment
[NEW] At most one open shopping task per item at any time (enforced by unique index on (item_id) WHERE status = 'open' and validated at the API level with 409 on conflict)
[NEW] shopping_task.status must be one of: open, done, dismissed (enforced at API and DB constraint level)
[NEW] shopping_task.source_tags is a JSON array of strings stored as jsonb; snapshot of item.source_tags at task creation time; not updated when item.source_tags changes

[NEW] On PATCH /shopping-tasks/{id} with status=done: if item has restock_quantity set, update item.quantity = restock_quantity and re-evaluate state (auto-transition may set state back to stored or keep low_stock if restock_quantity still <= min_quantity); if item has no restock_quantity, set item.state = stored and do not change quantity; in both cases, set task.completed_at = now()
[NEW] On PATCH /shopping-tasks/{id} with status=dismissed: set task.completed_at = now(); no change to item state or quantity
History is recorded for every state_change, location_change, quantity_change; creation is recorded as change_type=created
GET /api/items/{id} returns last 20 history entries embedded in the row
DELETE /api/items/{id} cascades to item_history and shopping_tasks (FK with ON DELETE CASCADE)
Schema is initialized idempotently at startup via schema.sql
PATCH /api/items/{id} distinguishes field omitted (no change) from field provided as explicit null (clear column) for all nullable fields
GET /api/items/views/search with empty or blank q returns empty Dataset
Route ordering: static paths (/api/items/views/*, /api/shopping-tasks/views/*) must be registered BEFORE parameterised paths (/api/items/{id}, /api/shopping-tasks/{id})
failure_modes: VALIDATION_ERROR — POST or PATCH with invalid field values — 400 ApiError
NOT_FOUND — GET, PATCH, or DELETE on unknown item or task id — 404 ApiError
INVALID_FILTER — GET /api/items or GET /api/shopping-tasks with unknown enum value — 400 ApiError
[NEW] CONFLICT — POST /api/shopping-tasks when an open task already exists for the item — 409 ApiError
DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE — Postgres unreachable — startup logs error and continues; requests fail until DB is reachable

provides: ItemRow: {id: str (UUID), name: str, item_type: str, state: str, location: str|null, notes: str|null, source_tags: list[str], quantity: int|null, min_quantity: int|null, restock_quantity: int|null, created_at: str (ISO datetime), updated_at: str (ISO datetime)} — emitted in Dataset rows by list and single-item endpoints

HistoryRow: {id: str (UUID), item_id: str (UUID), timestamp: str (ISO datetime), change_type: str, old_value: str|null, new_value: str|null, notes: str|null} — emitted in Dataset rows by history endpoint and embedded in single-item response

[NEW] ShoppingTaskRow: {id: str (UUID), item_id: str (UUID), item_name: str, status: str, source_tags: list[str], notes: str|null, created_at: str (ISO datetime), completed_at: str|null (ISO datetime)} — emitted in Dataset rows by all shopping task list and PATCH endpoints; source_tags is the snapshot from the item at task creation time

consumes: psycopg2.pool.SimpleConnectionPool (minconn=1, maxconn=5) via get_db() context manager — RealDictCursor
provides: HTTP API mounted at /api (FastAPI, uvicorn)
CORS: allow_origin_regex=http://localhost:\d+ — all localhost ports during development
Allowed methods: GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/items
exposed_surfaces.purpose: List all items with optional filters. Ordered by created_at DESC.

params.source_tag: string — matches items whose source_tags array contains this value — optional

exposed_surfaces.name: POST /api/items
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Create a new item. Applies auto-transition rule for low_stock. Records created history entry. If state becomes low_stock, auto-creates shopping task. Returns created item as Dataset.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/items/views/low_stock
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return items where state is low_stock or out_of_stock, ordered by name ASC.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/items/views/recycling
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return items where state is marked_for_recycling, ordered by name ASC.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/items/views/important
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return items where item_type is object, ordered by name ASC.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/items/views/search
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Case-insensitive substring search across name, location, notes. Returns empty Dataset for blank q.

params.q: search text — optional, default empty string; blank returns empty Dataset

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/items/{id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return single item with last 20 history entries embedded. Returns 404 ApiError if not found.

exposed_surfaces.name: PATCH /api/items/{id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Partial update including new restock_quantity field. Auto-recomputes state on quantity/min_quantity change. If state becomes low_stock or out_of_stock, auto-creates shopping task if none open exists. Returns updated item as Dataset.

exposed_surfaces.name: DELETE /api/items/{id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Delete item, cascade to item_history and shopping_tasks. Returns empty Dataset on success.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/items/{id}/history
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return full history for item ordered by timestamp DESC.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/shopping-tasks
exposed_surfaces.purpose: List shopping tasks. Default status=open. Optional source_tag filter (array-contains). Ordered by created_at ASC. Returns Dataset of ShoppingTaskRow.

params.status: one of open|done|dismissed — optional, default open
params.source_tag: string — matches tasks whose source_tags array contains this value — optional

exposed_surfaces.name: POST /api/shopping-tasks
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Manually create a shopping task for an item. item_id must reference an existing item. Status=open. Copies source_tags from item. Fails 409 if open task already exists for item. Returns Dataset (single row).

exposed_surfaces.name: PATCH /api/shopping-tasks/{id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Update task status (done or dismissed). On done: resets item state or quantity per restock_quantity invariant. Sets completed_at. Returns updated task as Dataset.

exposed_surfaces.name: DELETE /api/shopping-tasks/{id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Delete a shopping task. Returns empty Dataset on success, 404 ApiError if not found.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/shopping-tasks/views/by_source
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Open tasks expanded by source_tag — one row per (task, source_tag) combination. Tasks with no source tags produce one row with source_tag='Other'. Tasks with multiple source tags appear in each corresponding group. Rows are ShoppingTaskRow plus a source_tag column. Ordered: source_tags alphabetically, 'Other' last; within each group by created_at ASC.

internal_flow.name: startup_init
internal_flow.description: On FastAPI startup: init_pool() creates psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool. init_schema() reads schema.sql and executes DDL idempotently. Errors are logged; application continues running.
outputs: storagetracker schema with items, item_history, and shopping_tasks tables present in Postgres

internal_flow.name: item_list
internal_flow.description: GET /api/items validates filter params against enum allowlists. Builds WHERE clause from provided filters; source_tag filter uses jsonb array containment operator (@>). Executes SELECT ordered by created_at DESC. Returns Dataset.

internal_flow.name: item_create
internal_flow.description: POST /api/items validates name (non-blank), item_type, state (if provided), quantity (>= 0), min_quantity (>= 0), restock_quantity (>= 0 if provided). Applies auto-transition: if quantity and min_quantity are both non-null and quantity <= min_quantity, overrides state to low_stock (unless caller explicitly set state). Inserts item row with UUID. Inserts history row with change_type=created. If final state is low_stock or out_of_stock, calls _ensure_open_shopping_task(conn, item) to create task if needed. Returns Dataset (single row).

internal_flow.name: item_get
internal_flow.description: GET /api/items/{id} fetches item row. Fetches last 20 history entries ordered by timestamp DESC. Embeds history list in row under key 'history'. Returns Dataset (single row) or 404 ApiError.
outputs: Dataset (item row with embedded history list) | 404 ApiError

internal_flow.name: item_update
internal_flow.description: PATCH /api/items/{id} uses model_fields_set to identify explicitly provided fields. Validates restock_quantity (>= 0 if provided), state, quantity, min_quantity. Builds SET clause from provided fields only. After update: applies auto-transition if quantity or min_quantity changed and state not explicitly provided. If final state is low_stock or out_of_stock, calls _ensure_open_shopping_task(conn, item). Records history entries per changed field. Returns Dataset (single row) or 404 ApiError.

internal_flow.name: item_delete
internal_flow.description: DELETE /api/items/{id} executes DELETE RETURNING id. item_history and shopping_tasks rows are removed by ON DELETE CASCADE. Returns empty Dataset or 404 ApiError if no row deleted.

internal_flow.name: history_get
internal_flow.description: GET /api/items/{id}/history fetches item to confirm existence (404 if missing). Fetches all history rows ordered by timestamp DESC. Returns Dataset.

internal_flow.name: view_low_stock
internal_flow.description: GET /api/items/views/low_stock selects items WHERE state IN ('low_stock', 'out_of_stock') ORDER BY name ASC. Returns Dataset.

internal_flow.name: view_recycling
internal_flow.description: GET /api/items/views/recycling selects items WHERE state = 'marked_for_recycling' ORDER BY name ASC. Returns Dataset.

internal_flow.name: view_important
internal_flow.description: GET /api/items/views/important selects items WHERE item_type = 'object' ORDER BY name ASC. Returns Dataset.

internal_flow.name: view_search
internal_flow.description: GET /api/items/views/search validates q param. Empty or blank q returns empty Dataset immediately. Non-blank q executes SELECT WHERE lower(name) LIKE lower('%q%') OR lower(location) LIKE lower('%q%') OR lower(notes) LIKE lower('%q%') ORDER BY name ASC. Returns Dataset.

internal_flow.name: ensure_open_shopping_task
internal_flow.description: [NEW] Helper _ensure_open_shopping_task(conn, item_id, source_tags): checks if an open shopping task already exists for item_id (SELECT id FROM shopping_tasks WHERE item_id=? AND status='open'). If none found, inserts a new shopping_tasks row with status=open, source_tags=item.source_tags snapshot, created_at=now(). Called synchronously from item_create and item_update when final state is low_stock or out_of_stock. No return value; errors propagate to the caller transaction.
outputs: shopping task row inserted if not already present

internal_flow.name: shopping_task_list
internal_flow.description: [NEW] GET /api/shopping-tasks validates status param against enum allowlist. Builds WHERE clause: status filter (default open), optional source_tag filter using jsonb @> operator. Joins to items table to include item_name in result. Executes SELECT ordered by created_at ASC. Returns Dataset of ShoppingTaskRow.

internal_flow.name: shopping_task_create
internal_flow.description: [NEW] POST /api/shopping-tasks validates item_id exists (404 if not). Checks for existing open task (409 CONFLICT if found). Copies source_tags from item row. Inserts shopping_tasks row with status=open, created_at=now(), completed_at=null. Returns Dataset (single row including item_name).
outputs: Dataset (inserted shopping task row) | 404 ApiError | 409 ApiError

internal_flow.name: shopping_task_update
internal_flow.description: [NEW] PATCH /api/shopping-tasks/{id} fetches task (404 if not found). Validates status is done or dismissed (400 if invalid or already closed). Sets task.status and completed_at=now(). If status=done: fetches item; if item.restock_quantity is non-null, sets item.quantity=restock_quantity and re-evaluates auto-transition rule (updates item.state accordingly); if item.restock_quantity is null, sets item.state=stored without touching quantity. Records state_change history entry on item if state changed. If status=dismissed: no item update. Returns Dataset (updated task row).

internal_flow.name: shopping_task_delete
internal_flow.description: [NEW] DELETE /api/shopping-tasks/{id} executes DELETE RETURNING id. Returns empty Dataset or 404 ApiError.

internal_flow.name: view_by_source
internal_flow.description: [NEW] GET /api/shopping-tasks/views/by_source fetches all open shopping tasks joined to items (for item_name). Produces a flat Dataset: for each task, emit one row per element in task.source_tags, adding source_tag as a column. Tasks with empty source_tags produce one row with source_tag='Other'. Rows ordered by: source_tag ASC ('Other' sorted last via CASE), then created_at ASC within each group. Row shape: ShoppingTaskRow columns plus source_tag: str.
outputs: Dataset with one row per (task, source_tag) combination

internal_required.role: Shared Postgres instance — StorageTracker owns the storagetracker schema within it
Dataset, DatasetMeta, ColumnSchema — used in all read endpoint responses
api_error helper, exception handlers, request timing, structured logging

forbidden: Asynchronous task creation — auto-task creation is synchronous within the same request transaction

tables.name: storagetracker.items
tables.description: One row per tracked household item. source_tags stored as jsonb array. Sprint02 adds restock_quantity column.

tables.name: storagetracker.item_history
tables.description: Append-only log of state, location, and quantity changes. FK to items with ON DELETE CASCADE.

tables.name: [NEW] storagetracker.shopping_tasks
tables.description: One row per shopping task. Linked to an item. Status: open|done|dismissed. source_tags is a jsonb snapshot from item at task creation time. completed_at is null until task is closed.

persistence.notes: Sprint02 adds restock_quantity to items and the shopping_tasks table. Schema is additive — ALTER TABLE adds restock_quantity column; shopping_tasks uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. The schema.sql at component root is updated by the implementer to include all Sprint02 DDL.

views.name: All Items
views.description: Filterable list of all items. State/type chips for filtering. Items in low_stock or out_of_stock show a shopping-task indicator badge. Inline create and edit via modal.

views.name: Low Stock
views.description: Consumables that are low_stock or out_of_stock. Backed by GET /api/items/views/low_stock.

views.name: Important Items
views.description: Items where item_type is object. Focus on location column. Backed by GET /api/items/views/important.

views.name: Recycling
views.description: Items marked for recycling. Backed by GET /api/items/views/recycling.

views.name: Item Detail
views.description: Name, state badge, location, quantity and min_quantity (if consumable), restock_quantity (if set), source tags, history timeline. Button to manually create shopping task. Backed by GET /api/items/{id}.

views.name: [NEW] Shopping List
views.description: Open shopping tasks. Default view shows all open tasks. Optional grouping by source_tag (backed by GET /api/shopping-tasks/views/by_source). Each task row has one-tap done/dismiss actions. Backed by GET /api/shopping-tasks and GET /api/shopping-tasks/views/by_source.

ui.create_edit: ItemFormModal updated to include restock_quantity field for consumables. ShoppingTaskFormModal for manual task creation (just item selection + optional notes — source_tags are auto-populated from item).

risks.risk: Schema migration: restock_quantity added to live items table
risks.impact: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is safe in Postgres; existing rows will have restock_quantity = null which is correct default behavior

risks.risk: Auto-task creation and item update in same transaction
risks.impact: If task insert fails (e.g. duplicate open task due to race condition), the whole item update is rolled back. Acceptable for single-user use case.
